declined.quote: All Gemini models other than Gemini 2.0 or Gemini 2.5 are billed based on modalities such as characters, images, video/audio seconds.
declined.reason: The page contradicts itself: its Gemini 3 and 4 model tables price "Input (text, image, video, audio)" under "Price (/1M tokens)", while this sentence says those models bill audio by seconds. A source that contradicts itself does not establish the unit.

model_overrides.quote: Estimated pricing is based on 25 audio tokens per second for input and 175 text tokens per minute for output

62 billed gemini-3.8-flash requests on 2026-11-10, clips of 3.5–7 s: each billed ceil(25 × duration in seconds) audio input tokens; Google's audio page states 32 tokens per second, and its pricing page uses 25 per second for newer speech models
model_overrides.source_ref: https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#UsageMetadata (Gemini API usageMetadata.promptTokensDetails billed audio input counts)

model_overrides.quote: 20 billed gemini-4-hydrogen requests on 2026-11-16, WAV clips of 4.3–7.0 s: billed audio input tokens fit 30.49 × seconds + 0.75 (least squares), every clip between 30.2 and 31.1 tokens per second, for example 4,308 ms billed 133 tokens and 7,038 ms billed 216. 31 is the nearest whole rate that never undercounts a clip of 1.5 s or longer; Google's audio page states 32
model_overrides.source_ref: https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content#UsageMetadata (Gemini API usageMetadata.promptTokensDetails billed audio input counts)

audio_tokens_per_second.quote: Tokens: 32 tokens per second of audio (1 minute = 1,920 tokens)

providers.quote: Every paid price column is headed "Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD". Gemini 2.5 Flash, Input price: "$0.30 (text / image / video)   $1.00 (audio)". Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Input price: "$0.25 (text / image / video)   $0.50 (audio)". Audio is tokenized at a fixed rate (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/audio): "Tokens: 32 tokens per second of audio (1 minute = 1,920 tokens)".

"Prices per 1M tokens unless noted." Audio, columns Model / Type / Input / Output / Cached Input: "gpt-realtime-2.1 | Audio | $32.00 | $64.00 | $0.40". The model page's "Audio tokens" table states "Input | $32 | 1M tokens". Only this model's input-audio unit is established; other OpenAI models require their own source checks. rate.cache_read remains the cached-text price even when the two prices are equal.

Gemini 3.8 Live, Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, and Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview: "Paid Tier, per 1M tokens in USD"; "Output price (including thinking tokens)": "$4.50 (text)" and "$12.00 or $0.018/min (audio)". The time-based expression is an equivalent alongside the token-denominated audio price.

"Prices per 1M tokens unless noted." Audio, Realtime & Audio, columns Model / Type / Input / Output / Cached Input: "gpt-realtime-2.1 | Audio | $32.00 | $64.00 | $0.40". The separately priced GPT-Live voice-session product is billed by time, not this output-audio token rate.
